## 6. Enhancement of ceiling of HBA sanctioned on or after 1-1-2016 but before 9-11-2017.-  
An enhancement of House Building Advance, if applied for, would be granted for an amount equivalent to the difference between the previously sanctioned amount and the new eligible amount determined on the basis of basic pay as per Seventh CPC, subject to complying following
